data.description: EVT-12. The JSON Schema of this event type's data — the `data` of the CloudEvents envelope EVT-1 fixes. The Worker's own shape: this protocol has no data model.

destination.description: EVT-13. Where THIS type lands on the broker, for a Worker that divides its events by subject. Absent, it lands at the entry's destination, which is the ordinary case.

supersededBy.description: NAME-10. The event type that replaces this one, by the name `publishes` holds it under. This type is still published exactly as declared. Followed from any type, it ends at one that names none — which no schema of one entry can assert, so the verifier judges it.

title: Event type declaration
description: EVT-12. One event type, held under a qualified name (EVT-4, NAME-7) because a subscriber matches it against what it decided to consume, having never met the team that minted it.
